import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
from collections import defaultdict
groups = defaultdict(list)
for r in range(4,10):
    iid = ws.cell(r,1).value
    imp = ws.cell(r,2).value
    lik = ws.cell(r,3).value
    groups[(imp,lik)].append(iid)
for (imp,lik),ids in groups.items():
    row = 14 - (imp-1)
    col = 7 + (lik-1)
    ws.cell(row, col).value = ','.join(str(i) for i in ids)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
